'''Vondral''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that served the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] on the ''[[Executioner (Harrower-class)|Executioner]]'' during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Retaliation" />
